task1_vfc_lane_conflict_adjudication.d2_ruling: D2-FAIL CONFIRMED as of the latest print. Vans is not proven dead-forever (Americas DTC growth is a real partial counter-signal), but the D2 bar is 'damaged-but-DURABLE demand', and a franchise with zero growth quarters in three years whose decline rate just re-accelerated (-5% -> -9%) with wholesale still shrinking has not cleared it. The value in VFC verifiably sits in TNF/Timberland/Altra + deleveraging — a portfolio/SOTP story, which is precisely NOT the great-man mechanism (leader fixes the flagship franchise). task1_vfc_lane_conflict_adjudication.clock_ruling: ARCHETYPE DOES NOT APPLY at 12.2 qtrs in-seat. Twelve quarters of doubt-never-paid is not a pending payoff — it is the market repeatedly declining to pay, and it declined again, violently, on a beat-and-raise two days ago. task1_vfc_lane_conflict_adjudication.basis_paragraph: Both lanes were half-right about different eras of the same name, and the two-day-old print adjudicates them. The grounding lane measured 2023-2025, when Darrell (D1-pass) ran the playbook competently into a Vans franchise that would not respond — that window produced -67pp 2y alpha and is correctly frozen as the study's D2-FAIL control. The sourcing lane saw the 2026 stock: genuinely cheap, deleveraged, total revenue back to modest growth — but mislabeled a sum-of-parts value case as a great-man PRIME. The Q1 FY27 print (Jul-29-2026) is dispositive on both axes: the company beat and raised, yet Vans re-widened to -9% C$ after reaching -5%, has still never printed a growth quarter under Darrell, and the stock gave back -17.4% on the news — the doubt discount is a Vans discount, and Vans has not inflected. At 12.2 quarters with the restructuring complete and the ADS-comp premium window (q12-14) closing, there is no archetype trade left to underwrite; there is a value trade with different gates. VFC exits the great-man cohort as a confirmed D2-FAIL; the grounding control stands unchanged.
